These are the exact quilt/Whitehead scope distinctions, not an artificial phenomenality perimeter.

review_findings.complete_paragraph: Consider a local inquiry into a disputed institutional judgment. A comparing agent is its relative functional knower; records, memory, rules and authorised tools are means; the claim and alternatives compared are known.
